title: Entry speed value
description: Essential Criteria: The response must state the rod's speed upon entering the magnetic field as 2 m/s.

title: Force balance reasoning
description: Important Criteria: The solution must apply Newton's second law or force balance (mgsinθ = BIL) for constant velocity entry.

title: Distance d_0 value
description: Essential Criteria: The response must state the initial distance d_0 as 0.4 m.

title: Energy conservation for d_0
description: Important Criteria: The solution must use conservation of energy (mgh = ½mv²) to relate d_0 to the entry speed.

title: Joule heat Q_R value
description: Essential Criteria: The response must state the Joule heat on resistor R as 0.096 J.

title: Current and time calculation
description: Important Criteria: The solution must calculate the induced current (I = BLv/(R+r)) and the transit time (t = d/v) to find the heat.

title: Motional EMF application
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly apply the formula for motional EMF (E = BLv) in the inclined setup.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the force direction (magnetic vs. gravitational) is incorrectly assigned, leading to wrong equations.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional Criteria: Award if all final answers include correct SI units (m/s, m, J) and intermediate steps show unit analysis.

title: Circuit resistance omission
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the total circuit resistance (R+r) is not used in the current or power calculations.
